column45: Children who live in NYC are eligible to begin 2-K during the fall of the calendar year they turn 2. Family child care programs, also known as home-based programs, offer early care and education in a home setting by a licensed, qualified child care provider. 2-K children are served in mixed-age groups with other children from birth to four years old. For more information about this program, please reach out to the family child care network using the email address and phone number listed above. Each 2-K program will have either Expanded Day and Full Year (EDFY) or School Day and Year (SDY) seats. Please check the types of seats available in 2-K programs and list those that meet your needs on your application. For more information, please click on the options listed below or visit schools.nyc.gov/2k. Each early childhood setting offers key health supports. FCCs are required to have staff trained in basic first aid, CPR, and Medication Administration Training if an enrolled student requires medication during the school day. Please contact EarlyChildhoodHealth@schools.nyc.gov with any questions about health supports available for your child's medical needs.
